recentItems.description:
👉🏻 SUBSCRIBE to Zee Music Company - https://bit.ly/ZeeMusicCo  

Song: Chaap Tilak - Laikey Laikaa
Movie: Laikey Laikaa
Singers: Rasha Thadani & IP Singh
Music Composer: Faridkot (Rajarshi Sanyal & IP Singh)
Lyricist: Siddharth-Garima & IP Singh
Music Arranger & Programmer: Rajarshi Sanyal
Acoustic Guitars: Rajarshi Sanyal & Jatin Mangal

Starring: Rasha Thadani & Abhay Verma
Director: Saurabh Gupta
Producers: Bhavna Talwar & Raghav Gupta
Production House: Phantom Studios & N2O Films

Lyrics:
Rabba pee di vasl da mainu
Sabr na bakhsheen
Je sabr likheya meri laqeeri ch
Te qabr na bakhsheen

Mukhda-
Tod ke bandh main
Odh ke chaand ka
Qatra qatra beh gayi
Daal ke aankh mein
Surma raakh ka
Qatra qatra reh gayi
Aaj naachungi pairon mein bijlee saja ke
Maine rakhein hain daaman mein jugnu chhipaa ke
Dhal jaaye jo chunari toh duniya phoonk de
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Main toh aaj falaq aaj falaq odh chali re
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Chhod chali re…

Punjabi part (Faridkot)-
Tere layi main taan duniya de naal
Kalla he lad jaawaan
Dekhe teri wal buri je nazar
Hatth usnu main paawaan
Dhupp je tainu hai tang kare taan main
Usnu vi bujhhavaan
Tenu rakhaan main bachaa ke bhaavein
Jaan he gawaavaan, yaara
Tu yaqeen hai
Taan main patthar di laqeer haan
Leen tu ravein
Duniya nu main devaan cheer
Teri taal meri saans ki
Hai dor bani re…
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Main toh aaj falaq aaj falaq odh chali re
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Chhod chali re…

Antara-
Mere mann ki taal pe
Baaje damru
Ishq zameen hai
Dard hai ghunghroo
Chham chham chham chhamak chhamak
Dam dam dam damak damak
(Repeat)-
Mere mann ki taal pe
Baaje damru
Ishq zameen hai
Dard hain ghunghroo
Main hoon aag lapat
Laaj sharam chhod chali re…
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Main toh aaj falaq aaj falaq odh chali re
Main toh Chaap tilak Chaap tilak chhod chali re
Main toh aaj falaq aaj falaq odh chali re
Chhod chali re…
Outro

recentItems.title: Ek Onkar - Guru Nanak Jayanti Special | Asees Kaur, Raghav Sachar | Sikh Devotional Song
recentItems.description:
Celebrate the divine message of oneness with Ek Onkar, a soulful Sikh devotional song sung by Asees Kaur and recreated by Raghav Sachar.

Ek Onkar (ੴ) represents the One Supreme Reality – the eternal, formless and all-pervading Creator. Rooted in the sacred Mool Mantar from Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, this timeless prayer reminds us of truth, fearlessness, compassion and the divine grace of the Almighty.

On the auspicious occasion of Guru Nanak Jayanti and Gurpurab, may the teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji inspire us to embrace unity, peace, humility and devotion.

MOOL MANTAR:
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

MEANING OF MOOL MANTAR:
• Ik Onkar (ੴ) – One Supreme Reality / One Creator
• Sat Naam – Truth is His Name
• Karta Purakh – The Creator Being
• Nirbhau – Without fear
• Nirvair – Without hatred or enmity
• Akaal Moorat – Timeless and beyond death
• Ajooni – Unborn
• Saibhang – Self-existent
• Gur Prasad – Realized through the Guru's grace

CREDITS:
Singer: Asees Kaur
Composer: Traditional Composition
Lyrics: Traditional Lyrics
Re-arrangement & Recreation: Raghav Sachar
Recorded at: AutoTune Studio
Mixing & Mastering: Raghav Sachar

May the divine words of Ek Onkar bring peace, positivity and blessings into your life.

Happy Guru Nanak Jayanti! 🙏
